x.label: Round growth in n · fixed ε, δ; fixed λ≥2 in arboric rows
x.scaleNote: Symbolic upper-bound growth classes, not numerical distance. Exact parameter formulas are displayed per row; unknown polylog exponents share one class.

axisSummary.x: MPC round growth in n for fixed ε, δ and λ≥2; exact formulas retained
axisSummary.y: Algorithm and graph setup; quality labels retain expectation / probability

lowerBoundStatus: No general lower bound verified in the reviewed sources.
sourceVerification: All eight supplied primary texts inspected at theorem level. Same-model CC round lower bounds were not established; two verified barriers are confined to related framework/subroutine cards.
notes: Trees are included in the forest setup; arboricity assumptions concern the positive-edge graph, not the full signed complete graph.
The visual groups n-growth only after fixing ε, δ and λ. It does not rank unknown parameter exponents or assert equal memory across papers.
For Pruned Pivot, total memory includes O(n·k^(k+1)) with k=O(1/ε).
Model 1 of Cambus et al. specifies M machines and S=Õ(n^δ); its definition alone is not proof of a tight O(m) global cap.
All-norm, communication-only and extra-machine results retain separate scopes.
